sources.citation: Sneddon, J.N. 1978. Proto-Minahasan: phonology, morphology and wordlist. Pacific Linguistics B-54. Canberra: ANU.
sources.note: Sec. 2.1.2 Tonsea Phonology (pp. 21-22) covers segmental phonemes, allophones, distribution and clusters only; no stress statement for Tonsea. The book's only stress remark is note 90 (p. 192) on Tondano: 'Optional lengthening of the vowel in Tdn only occurs when the word is stressed.' Checked with a spaced-letter regex over the scanned.
